model.name: gpt-oss-20b (agent, no rules)
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (3.6B active), MXFP4 as released. The model approved today; the baseline every other profile is read against.

answers.sql:
WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d_br.BR_K, d_br.DSPLY_NM, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT BR_K, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM t
GROUP BY BR_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31');

SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY currency;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT a.BR_K, d.CTY_NM, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON a.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d_dt.QTR_NBR = 1
)
SELECT CTY_NM AS city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_with_txn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM cust_with_txn);

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, f.IS_ESCLT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE c.IS_ESCLT
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
         COUNT(*) AS alert_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
  GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT jurisdiction, alert_count FROM alerts;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN target_date t ON d.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%mobile app%'
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

WITH dt AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN dt d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d_br.RGN_CD1, d_br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.ORGNL_AMT, d.CAL_DT, m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.AMT::numeric AS amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(t.amt) AS total_amt
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1, CAST(f.AMT AS NUMERIC) AS amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(amt) AS total_amt
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT yr, cnt FROM t ORDER BY yr;

WITH last_intrc AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, MAX(CNTCT_STRTD_AT) AS last_intrc_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC
  GROUP BY CUST_K
), last_txn AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, MAX(PSTD_AT) AS last_txn_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
  GROUP BY CUST_K
)
SELECT d.CUST_K,
       d.BUS_ID,
       d.DSPLY_NM,
       li.last_intrc_dt,
       lt.last_txn_dt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
LEFT JOIN last_intrc li ON d.CUST_K = li.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN last_txn lt ON d.CUST_K = lt.CUST_K
WHERE (li.last_intrc_dt IS NULL OR li.last_intrc_dt < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')
   OR (lt.last_txn_dt IS NULL OR lt.last_txn_dt < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')
ORDER BY COALESCE(li.last_intrc_dt, lt.last_txn_dt) NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT branch_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY branch_name
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31');

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = (SELECT MAX(CAL_DT) FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT <= '2023-08-31');

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       f.ccy_cd1 AS currency,
       ROUND(AVG(f.avrg_rt), 6) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.ccy_cd1
ORDER BY f.ccy_cd1;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, d.CTY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, d.CTY_NM
)
SELECT CTY_NM, SUM(txn_cnt) AS atm_txn_per_city
FROM txn
GROUP BY CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_per_city DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

WITH fx AS (
  SELECT f.MID_RT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.CAL_DT) = 12
)
SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM fx;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), all_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM all_cust a
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON a.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM, f.IS_ESCLT, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM c
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT, f.CHNL_K, dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT d.CHNL_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM,
       SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON t.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
GROUP BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fee DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH a AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM a;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_loans
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
  WHERE d.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
)
SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

WITH cross_border AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM cross_border cb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON cb.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, d.RGN_CD1, d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, d.RGN_CD1, d.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn r
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM, txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.ORGNL_AMT, d.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d ON f.MRCH_K = d.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(t.AMT::numeric) AS total_amt
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  SUM(CAST(f.AMT AS NUMERIC)) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire
WHERE CUST_K IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM atm);

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH last_txn AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, MAX(PSTD_AT) AS last_txn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
  GROUP BY CUST_K
), inactive AS (
  SELECT d.CUST_K, d.BUS_ID, d.DSPLY_NM, l.last_txn
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
  LEFT JOIN last_txn l ON d.CUST_K = l.CUST_K
  WHERE l.last_txn < date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - interval '3 months'
    OR l.last_txn IS NULL
)
SELECT * FROM inactive
ORDER BY last_txn NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 20;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_K, f.STLM_AMT, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.CCY_NM, SUM(t.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
GROUP BY c.CCY_NM
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT BR_K, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BR_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31';

WITH complaints AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.CAL_DT as business_date
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT c.CMPLT_CTG_K, ct.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaints c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.CMPLT_CTG_K, ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dldq.CUST_K) AS default_clients
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dldq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON dldq.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2023-08-31' AND dldq.DFLT_FLG = true;

WITH d AS (SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT) SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate_2025 FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY avg_daily_rate_2025 DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT d.CTY_NM AS city, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY d.CTY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND MTH_NBR = 12
)
SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD';

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

WITH cust_2025_txn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM cust_2025_txn);

WITH total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), declined AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED'
)
SELECT ROUND(declined.cnt::numeric / total.cnt * 100, 2) AS declined_pct
FROM declined, total;

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM, f.IS_ESCLT, d_dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM cte
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.FEE_AMT, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM t
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY jurisdiction_name
ORDER BY high_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_loans
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chnl ON f.CHNL_K = d_chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_chnl.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%mobile app%'
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC;

WITH cross_border AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM cross_border cb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON cb.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR
), max_txn AS (
  SELECT b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM, t.txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY t.txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM, txn_cnt
FROM max_txn
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.ORGNL_AMT, m.MRCH_CTG_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT BUS_ID, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total
FROM f
GROUP BY BUS_ID
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(CAST(AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS total_amount
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
